summary: An attacker compromised a Telegram account and used access to existing chat history to impersonate a trusted contact within ongoing conversations. Over approximately two months the attacker inserted loan requests that persuaded the victim to transfer nearly 10000 dollars.
user_mistake: sent funds based on requests received through a compromised trusted contacts Telegram account
prevention: Confirm unexpected money requests with the contact through a separate communication channel / Enable Telegram two factor authentication and remove unknown login sessions
